title: Todoist vs TickTick: Which To-Do App Is Right for You?
caption: Video: Todoist vs TickTick in five rounds, plus a bonus round (2:52)
description: Todoist or TickTick? Todoist for the fastest way to get tasks out of your head and a clean list, TickTick for a timer, habits, a calendar and a priority matrix in one app. Five rounds: getting tasks out of your head, seeing your time, everything in one app, keeping it simple, and devices.
chapters: Round 1: Getting tasks out of your head
Bonus round: the moment you freeze
FOCO, for when you can't begin
